title: PIMP Activation
concept_summary: Built as heartland rock, it stays with a man still trying to make his own excuse sound clean. The pressure comes from keeping the decent version alive while the compromise keeps showing through. It leaves the release in the excuse still hanging there instead of confession.

signal_stack.identity: man talking himself back into the decent version of what he did
signal_stack.emotional_arc: Self-justification -> cracks show -> no clean admission
signal_stack.genre_framework: heartland rock, maybe a little Springsteen-esque storytelling but stripped down

lyrics:
[Intro]
I did what I had to
still going around the same thing

[Verse 1]
late paychecks, missed calls, little things I can explain away
no big crime in it, just corners worn smooth
still talkin' like a good man mostly

[Pre-Chorus]
I did what I had to
late paychecks, missed calls, stuff like that
keeps the clean version out front

[Chorus]
I did what I had to
that's what I keep callin' it

[Bridge]
ain't sayin' I was right
just keep sayin' I had to

[Outro]
I did what I had to
still call it that
